registration.statement: The One-based Fold scale support is generated uniquely by binary succession R_next=2R, with exact relative spacing One/R and one local carrier act per support cell. The complete prime sectors share this one axis. In the binary electroweak sector, charged holding support (R+1)/(R+2) and neutral half-One force the squared share (R+2)^2/[4(R+1)^2+(R+2)^2], which strictly descends at every binary successor. Complete terminal promotion has support sixteen; holding the three generator directions forces active level thirteen, base 225/1009 and the single terminal alpha return over seventeen already admitted as the exact on-shell result. The source 2+R is a binary Fold power only at support two. Every common exact rational unit rescaling preserves like-dimension ratios, while the admitted proton-Planck relation fixes the physical scale ratio before any dimensional unit name or measured reference is applied post-seal.
registration.title: Common Fold scale axis and terminal electroweak transport
